title: The slow sync and query-log tests fit the Windows CI budget
goal: On the kb-tests-windows hosted runner no test runs past 300 s: the test_sync.py scenario fixture, test_querylog.py applied and the test_querylog_e2e.py scenario, which start child kbgit.py sync --push and query-log pipelines, take less time on Windows, and the job finishes inside its timeout.
notes: Needs a Windows machine. A local Windows run (Windows 11, cp1250 locale, Python 3.14.7, uv 0.12.19, Git for Windows 2.55, 8 xdist workers) at 3ff06b7: no test hung; the suite took 895 s. faulthandler stacks of the three tests past 300 s, all waiting in subprocess.run on a child pipeline in a temp repo: test_sync.py:127 scenario (conftest.py:148 kbgit), test_querylog.py:1941 applied, test_querylog_e2e.py:365 scenario (:221 distill, :206 run, test_querylog.py:2339 run_here). test_child_survives_a_kill_on_close_job passes there. The CI job timeout is TK-xwwg2ozp.
